user_authorization: Plan, implement, benchmark. Apply E14 evidence/justification standard through bounded reversible slices; this record does not mark the full overhaul complete.
parent_steps: M1 (cheap provisional feedback and authoritative click)

decision.problem: Every hover event previously ran full Construction.preview, including repeated visibility/clearance-path searches. The four original default-game cases missed the six-site workload.
principles: Separate presentation feedback from authoritative commands
Single canonical geometry owner; detached read-only query
Validate current state at the commit boundary
Optimize measured work; retain simple mechanisms until alternatives earn their cost
decision.choice: Use fresh canonical Rect2 footprint/bounds/entrance checks for event-driven provisional hover. Share those exact checks with full preview. Keep complete access/connectivity checks on explicit Preview legal site and every place command. Render provisional success amber and explain that the click checks access.
decision.owners: ConstructionService owns both read contracts and authoritative placement; BaseDemo selects the query based on input intent; BaseMap presents the provisional state.
triggers: Placement command; always its own current position and state

alternatives.option: Keep full route validation for every pointer event
alternatives.assessment: Rejected: three native six-site runs exceeded the unchanged 100 ms frame gate in under a second.

alternatives.option: Trust the previous hover result at click
alternatives.assessment: Rejected: protected-lane and changed-obstruction same-frame tests prove why admission must read current facts.

alternatives.option: Introduce an Area2D collider mirror immediately
alternatives.assessment: Deferred: geometry hints already measure in microseconds at six sites, while the current ledger does not declare a scoped stock-change signal. A mirror adds producers/lifetime synchronization for cancelled sites retaining stock and physics-step/pause/transform obligations. No Area2D performance superiority or inferiority is claimed; no comparative physics benchmark was executed.

alternatives.option: Cache full route answers across pointer positions
alternatives.assessment: Deferred: avoiding full route work on the interaction path removes the immediate cost without stale-access cache invalidation obligations.

evidence: Three separately restarted failed before runs and three passing 30-second hover/post-placement observations, below.
Six query/commit tests including every buildable kind/orientation, retained stock, purity, path-call tracing and blocked/stale commit.
Native traces prove hover never calls full validation/path searches and stationary input does not poll.
Mechanical source comparison proves the extracted shared geometry checks and remaining full-validator tail are unchanged.
Godot documents Rect2 geometry and Area2D physics-step overlap updates; engine facilities do not by themselves establish application performance.
tradeoffs: Hover no longer guarantees access/connectivity. Its success is explicitly provisional; final validation may reject.

Geometry still scans current instances on an input event. This is not a recurring application poll and is not a measured bottleneck in the tested six-site state. Larger populations remain an explicit unmeasured limit.
Current global simulation dispatch, read fanout and roughly 50 ms p99 live frames remain outside this slice.
Cancelled/dismantled stock rules remain canonical; no physics-space or cached geometry authority was introduced.
decision.acceptance: The bounded R30/R31 interaction requirements pass; whole-system R25-R32 and all-menu/cancellation acceptance are incomplete. Limits remain 100 ms frame/action, 30000 inspections/s and 0.25 s placement progress/debt allowance.
decision.rollback: Restore the previous hover connection and UI query branch together, or revert the three runtime file changes as one slice. The full placement validator, state format, jobs and clocks retain their prior rules; no state conversion is required.

ledger_signal_declarations_observed: signal entity_moved(entity_id: String, start: Vector2, finish: Vector2)
implementation.call_graph: Map input -> preview_build_hint_at -> preview_build_at(full_validation=false) -> placement_hint -> _footprint_preview. Explicit preview -> preview(full rules). Click -> place -> preview(full rules) -> commit.

benchmark_protocol.engine: Installed Godot 4.7.2 stable Steam ed1daf0bf; workspace-local executable copy verified equal to installed binary. Portable editor/user data kept inside the workspace for restricted test execution.
benchmark_protocol.native_fixture: Actual connected default empty-field game; prepare six legal construction sites while paused through public domain commands, resume via player controls, select workshop with GUI input, issue eight unaccumulated viewport motions per rendered frame, place at a fractional arbitrary coordinate and observe. No substitution of the world.
benchmark_protocol.renderer_viewport_cap: GL compatibility; 1280x720; 60 fps cap; 1x; same current scene and fixture for before/after.
benchmark_protocol.native_instrumentation: Counters on, caller stacks off, optional stage profiling off. A separate default-stack run validates attribution compatibility. No performance threshold is relaxed.
benchmark_protocol.native_duration: Each run targets 30 seconds hover and 30 seconds post-placement. Before runs abort on the first >100 ms frame after about one second; before distributions are truncated and are not a matched 30-second performance baseline.
benchmark_protocol.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p over retained raw observations, per run; p50/p95/p99/max are descriptive. Consecutive frames/events are correlated; no confidence interval or whole-game speed factor is claimed.
benchmark_protocol.query_fixture: Separate equivalent six-site paused fixtures, eight warmup queries/mode, 192 identical poses per mode per batch, three alternating-order batches. Counters off only inside timed calls. Confirm unchanged sites, ledger and time.
benchmark_protocol.query_limit: Compares the cost of a complete validator with intentionally narrower provisional geometry; it proves the saving from removing route work, not semantic equivalence of hint and full validation. Commit retains the complete validator.
benchmark_protocol.replication_order: Three before failures, then three after passes; not randomized old/new order. Record timing noise/drift limitations and independent per-run results.
